integrity: Analytical proof with exact reproducible finite checks; historical priority is qualified by incomplete access to an older same-graph publication. Not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge, once-subdivided complete graphs only; weighted and nonuniform subdivisions not addressed.
The n=2 and n=3 cases are classical boundaries; substantive classification is for n>=4.
title: Exact Hilbert distortion of complete-graph subdivisions
